original_test_intent: Verify the Type 4 Asset Tag string for every processor record matches the approved inventory value or explicit blank/not-applicable policy and remains associated with the same socket after reboot, without writing asset metadata.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, retain each Asset Tag string index and resolved text with socket/handle, normalize only under an approved inventory policy, compare with the expected map, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the processor asset-tag inventory or blank policy, normalization and reboot plan. Read-only collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected Asset Tag per processor/socket or approved blank/not-applicable state
Authoritative inventory and Type 4 socket/handle mapping
Rules for whitespace, placeholder, case and duplicate values
Evidence access/retention policy for inventory identifiers
Validated parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not write asset metadata, alter CPU state or modify firmware.
Preserve the raw string index and full Type 4 context; generic grep can select Asset Tag from another SMBIOS structure.
Do not equate Asset Tag with processor serial, part number or a physical label unless the project explicitly maps them.
Accept blank/not-applicable only when approved; distinguish it from a missing formatted field, bad string index or parser failure.
Stop on unauthorized metadata exposure, ambiguity, unapproved drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 4 records, map socket/handle, resolve and normalize Asset Tag under policy and compare before/after reboot.
Do not program tags, substitute another identifier or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the asset inventory, blank/placeholder and normalization policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The text label is relevant, but the grep can mix Asset Tag fields across structure types and lacks string-index and processor-context evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 4 raw/decoded records, retain socket/handle/string index and compare normalized values with the authoritative processor-asset map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Asset Tag scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the Type 4 Asset Tag string for every expected processor record, distinguish an approved blank from malformed absence and compare with the inventory mapping before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems where Asset Tag is represented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, inventory, parser/dmidecode and project-policy revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Asset Tag string semantics, approved asset inventory and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structure-qualified collection, raw string-index provenance, inventory mapping and explicit blank handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; eliminates cross-structure false matches and unverifiable display-only evidence.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Asset map or blank policy and normalization rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field can be administrative metadata and may legitimately be blank; it does not prove CPU identity by itself.

project_override_considerations: A project may require exact administrative tags, masked comparisons or documented blank values. It must not silently compare the field with a serial-number or chassis-asset source.
expected_evidence: Approved processor asset map/blank policy, normalization and platform/tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 capture with socket/handle/raw string index and resolved tag
Masked or controlled comparison with the authoritative inventory
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot capture
Engineer verdict with any documented blank/placeholder use

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets the Type 4 Asset Tag; its allowed contents are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only capture is safe and deterministic once the inventory/blank policy is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete Type 4 context, raw string-index provenance and inventory/blank semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its useful mapping and blank policy while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and separating verdict ownership.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly prevents cross-structure grep matches and identifier substitution.

review_improvement: Distinguishes valid administrative absence from malformed strings and prevents a chassis or processor serial from being mistaken for this field.
independent_technical_reasoning: With an approved asset mapping, every core step—collection, resolution, normalization, comparison and reboot persistence—is software-controlled.
